conviction_note: First quarter with Kloeckner consolidated (from 2026-06-03) and with $1.4bn of new acquisition debt at about 8%. WS's own pro forma (8-K/A, 2026-08-19) puts combined 9M FY26 diluted EPS at $0.56 against $1.30 standalone, which is roughly $0.25 a quarter of dilution. The aggregator bar ($0.92 EPS at MarketBeat, $1.16 EPS and $886m revenue elsewhere, FY27 revenue $3.6-3.7bn) looks legacy-only, so a headline EPS miss is the lean. The bar is disputed, though, so findings are capped small and p_up sits at 44 (draft 42). abs_move is 8 against a 6.87 median because this is a new consolidated framework and a first post-deal call. The findings sum to -1.40, a little larger than the scaled -0.96 because p_up carries the bar caveat.
bar: Disputed and probably stale. MarketBeat consensus EPS is $0.92 for Q1 FY27 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/WS/earnings/). Another aggregator shows $1.16 EPS and $885.9m revenue (search snippet, tipranks/vcpscanner). FY27 revenue estimates of $3.60-3.73bn (https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/materials/nyse-ws/worthington-steel/news/worthington-steel-inc-just-beat-earnings-expectations-heres) cannot include Kloeckner's EUR 6.4bn a year of sales. No company guide exists apart from $10-15m of Q1 inventory holding gains. Every size here is capped small. print_vs_bar_pct is EPS against $0.92, estimated at about $0.70-0.80 (legacy about $0.80-0.95 less about $0.15-0.25 of deal dilution). Reported revenue will look like a 2-3x 'beat' that means nothing.
positioning_check: Short interest 1,447,294 shares, 3.47% of float, 3.55 days to cover, up 13.4% month on month (MarketBeat short-interest page, https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSE/WS/short-interest, settlement date not shown, served October 2026). The sweep had 3.47% and 4.1 DTC as of 2025-09-15 (https://fintel.io/ss/us/ws). Not a crowded short, so no squeeze discount on the negatives. Skew is not available: the chain is unusable (ATM spread 100% of mid, 121 contracts of total OI, put/call OI 0.36). Tape: +10.1% over 5 sessions and +10.3% over 20 into the print, -19.4% from the 52-week high. 1 up in 7 prior reactions. The last two prints fell 7.0% and 14.9%.

findings.finding: WS's own unaudited pro forma (8-K/A Ex. 99.2) shows the Kloeckner deal is heavily dilutive to EPS: combined 9M FY26 diluted EPS $0.56 against $1.30 standalone, and FY25 $(0.25) against $2.19. The drivers are $89.3m of 9-month incremental interest on a $700m SOFR+~4.0% term loan and $700m of ~7.8% secured notes, plus 38% minority interest. Q1 FY27 (Jun-Aug) is the first quarter carrying all of it, so it lands against an aggregator EPS bar ($0.92-$1.16) that sits above last year's legacy $0.77 and paired revenue estimates that exclude Kloeckner.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: EPS misses have been sold hard: Q3 FY26 $0.27 vs $0.47 fell 14.9% (2026-03-26). Q4 FY26 $0.74 vs $0.73 with a revenue miss fell 7.0% (2026-06-25). An in-line Q1 FY26 beat ($0.77 vs $0.72) moved -0.23% (MarketBeat earnings table, baseline history).
findings.why_not_priced: The document is public, but the visible estimate sets are not built on it. If they were, consensus revenue for the quarter would be about $2.5bn+ rather than $886m, FY27 revenue estimates would be about $9bn rather than $3.6-3.7bn, and consensus EPS would sit below the $0.74-0.77 legacy run rate rather than at $0.92-1.16. With three covering analysts and a stock up 10% in five sessions, the price is not leaning on a dilution print.
findings.independence: The acquisition financing is also in the 8-K of 2026-06-30 (items 1.01/2.03) and the same pro forma document. That is one fact, filed once. The Kloeckner earnings weakness that feeds into it is filed separately (Kloeckner H1 report).

findings.finding: Kloeckner's H1 2026 report (Vorstand, 2026-08-04) cut its Kloeckner Metals Americas FY26 EBITDA outlook from 'leichter Anstieg' to 'leichter Rückgang' and Americas volume stays 'deutlicher Rückgang'. The group FY midpoint of EUR 210m against H1's EUR 109m implies about EUR 50m a quarter in H2, below Q2's EUR 63m. So the business WS consolidated from 2026-06-03 was guided to a softer run rate for the months inside WS's Q1. Europe's guided 'deutlicher Anstieg' partly offsets this.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior WS print carried Kloeckner. Kloeckner itself was delisted on 2026-08-12, so there is no reaction to read.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a German-language interim report from a now-delisted subsidiary, and the US estimate sets visibly do not model Kloeckner at all (see bar). If US holders were reading it, consensus would carry a Kloeckner EBITDA line near EUR 50-60m a quarter, and the 10% run-up into the print would be hard to square with a softer acquired business.
findings.independence: Ryerson's Q3 2026 guide (2026-07-29: shipments down 3-5% sequentially, prices flat to +2%) points to soft North American service-center volume. That is a different source and is filed separately below.

findings.finding: US flat-rolled prices rose through WS's quarter. SMU's HRC average was $1,115/st on 9 June and $1,145/st on 23 June, and HRC was $1,180/st on 4 August, still firming in late August. Nucor (2026-09-17) and Steel Dynamics guided Q3 to higher realized selling values. So WS's Q1 inventory holding gains should land at or above the top of the $10-15m it guided on 2026-06-25, and the rising prices also help Kloeckner's margins.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Holding gains of $14.7m in Q4 FY26 came against a fall of 7.0%. The name has not been paid for holding-gain-driven beats.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The company guided this line, and the result probably lands inside or just above that guide. It is filed small for the upside beyond $15m only.
findings.independence: Nucor Q3 2026 guidance, steel mills on higher average selling prices (https://www.steelorbis.com/steel-news/latest-news/nucor-issues-q3-2026-earnings-guidance-expects-higher-steel-mills-and-steel-products-earnings-1478837.htm, 2026-09-17). Holding-gain guide $10-15m (https://stocktaper.com/earningsCallSummary/WS/2026/Q4, 2026-06-25).

findings.finding: Ryerson, the largest listed US service center and now including Olympic Steel, guided Q3 2026 (Jul-Sep) to shipments down 3-5% sequentially and selling prices only flat to up 2%. That is a soft volume read for service-center peers, overlapping WS's Jun-Aug quarter and the Kloeckner Metals Americas business.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Toll volumes fell 15% and total tons 4% in Q4 FY26, and the stock fell 7.0%. Volume softness has been sold.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a peer proxy, two months old, and small. It is filed as a proxy and sized small. If priced, WS's run-up would not have been +10% into the print.
findings.independence: Kloeckner's Americas outlook cut (finding 2) points the same way from a different document.

findings.finding: North American light-vehicle production was 1,384,007 units in June 2026 (+2.8% YoY) after May's -5.2%, and the 2026 forecast is 15.61m against 15.58m in 2025. That is flat-to-slightly-up auto output in the first month of WS's quarter, and auto is the legacy direct business's largest end market.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Legacy direct volumes rose 1% in Q4 FY26 and the stock still fell 7.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a broad public macro series and largely priced. It is filed small as a proxy.

findings.finding: Electrical Steel (Tempel) carried a $94.5m goodwill and long-lived asset impairment in Q4 FY26 on weak industrial-motor demand in Europe and the US and delayed auto programme launches. No evidence since then of a recovery in the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Disclosed with Q4 FY26, and the stock fell 7.0% on 2026-06-25.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is in the wire copy. Sized near zero for continued weakness only.

findings.finding: Kloeckner booked a group net loss of EUR -268m in Q2 2026, with EUR -171m of special effects in EBITDA, mainly the Becker Group write-down tied to a planned divestment. Purchase accounting from 2026-06-03 resets those assets, so any residue in WS's Q1 is a GAAP-only item adjusted EPS should exclude.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q4 FY26 impairment ($94.5m GAAP loss) came with a 7.0% fall, but the release also missed on revenue. There is no clean read.
findings.why_not_priced: It sits below operating income, probably pre-acquisition or reset by purchase price allocation, and will be excluded from adjusted results. Sized at a fraction.

outside_window.finding: The Kloeckner domination and profit-and-loss transfer agreement (DPLTA) goes to a Kloeckner shareholder vote on 2026-10-23 and can take effect no earlier than 2027-01-01. It needs 75% approval and brings a minority compensation obligation.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The negative lean cuts against the +10% five-session run-up but fits the name's reaction history (1 up in 7, last two -7.0% and -14.9%). The run-up makes a miss costlier if the bar really is legacy-only.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (bar disputed: $0.92 vs $1.16, revenue estimates exclude Kloeckner): finding 1 capped from -1.5 to -1.0, and p_up moved from 42 to 44, so the scaled number went from -1.28 to -0.96
Rule 9 (net of the rest): the Kloeckner Americas cut is offset by Europe's guided 'deutlicher Anstieg', so finding 2 went from -0.8 to -0.5
Rule 6 (inside guidance) and rule 1 (this name does not pay for holding-gain beats): the price/holding-gain finding went from +0.6 to +0.3
Rule 2 (one-offs as one-offs): the Becker impairment went from -0.2 to -0.1 as a below-the-line item reset by purchase accounting
Rule 4 (financing is a question): the acquisition debt funds Kloeckner's earnings, which the pro forma already nets; finding 1 is about dilution against the bar, not distress, so its sign stands
Rule 7: short interest checked at 3.5% of float and 3.55 DTC, not crowded, so no squeeze discount
Added the Electrical Steel finding (-0.1) under the core's 'file every sourced fact' rule, not because of LESSONS; it was absent from the frozen draft
